dsh-message-rail is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Codex-style left-side message navigation rail for the Web UI: one tick per user message, hover previews, and click-to-jump across the whole history.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-cd9ea6e7b809adf93f23.html
